recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow active-source correction that completes the FHIR-5498 wording intent while preserving the no-change decision on empty Attachment behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-5498 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 MnM ballot issue for Attachment. It objected that the empty Attachment guidance said content was unavailable "for the reason stated" even though Attachment had no reason property, and the approved resolution was to fix the language so the assertion depends on language and MIME/content type instead.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite SVN revision 4533. In git-svn history, d8c3b09240e38503a709e6540aea5782e76cc4f7 corresponds to build@4533 and changed "for the reason stated" to language/content-type combination wording. Later commit 5ae1eebfcac2835ff22fdbbc1cdfb452b33ab838 updated surrounding Attachment documentation to contentType terminology but left this sentence with a stale code-styled mimeType reference.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps datatypes to datatypes.html, so source/datatypes.html is active build-scope narrative. FHIR-5499 reviewed the same empty Attachment assertion and was resolved no-change, supporting a narrow wording correction rather than deleting the behavior.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes.html to say that, if neither data nor URL is provided, no content is available for the specified contentType, language, or the combination of both.
source_changes: source/datatypes.html: replaced the obsolete `mimeType`/duplicative combination sentence in the Attachment constraints paragraph with current `contentType`, `language`, or both wording.

related_jiras.note: Same Attachment empty-content paragraph; resolved no-change on removing the behavior, so the reconciliation only clarifies wording.
Later Published Attachment.contentType issue helped confirm current datatype terminology, but was not independently decided.
